statement: The twelve specified seven-point restriction maps have a common nontrivial kernel on F13 and its full profinite completion. The joint kernel of all 36 six- and seven-point maps equals this kernel, through the exact 24 forgetting-of-one-pole maps. The explicit source word m_{-1} m_i m_1^{-1} m_i^{-1} maps to the identity. Its winding number about -1 is one, so its closure is a full Zhat contained in the common completed kernel. The injectivity route is refuted; the residual A5 centralizer comparison remains unresolved.
where_proved: Part F, statement F.9; work/part_a/f_seven_point_kernel.tex; code/part_a/seven_point_kernel_f9.py and its exact output
depends_on: F7 exact A4 orbit configuration and its seven-point restrictions; F8 exact target-relabelling identity and common kernels; A-Artin1947 Theorems 3 and 14
manuscript_passages: Section 30, folios 194-196, scans 383-387; Part F, nonsolvable A5 centralizer comparison on the twelve-punctured sphere
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The source curve, based polygonal meridians, normalized ordered configuration map, target quotient map, and full profinite winding detector are displayed explicitly.
notes: The executed certificate verifies the exact A4 label correspondence and all 144 matrix products, excludes domain and coordinate singularities on the Gaussian-rational paths, isolates all 64 crossings on 18 distinct segments by exact Sturm arithmetic, records all 270 coordinate-pair checks, and proves the braid identity through the faithful Artin action on F6. The three braid words have lengths 28,32,32. The source word has winding vector (1,0,-1) on the named meridians. F8 transports the same kernel element to all twelve maps. The separate seven_point_six_factorization_f9.py certificate lists all 24 inclusions of a six-set into the seven-set with the same C5 five-cycle and both fixed poles, proving the equality of the 12- and 36-fold kernels on both discrete and completed sources. Numerical crossing and finite Burau computations were discovery only. No element of the residual A5 centralizer is asserted.
